claims.sentence: Academic leave is available to students and postgraduate students enrolled in basic professional educational programs at the University
Conscription for military service or signing a contract for military service
Medical indications
Other exceptional cases, including natural disasters or family circumstances
The standard duration of academic leave is up to 12 calendar months at one time
However, for leave taken due to military service or medical indications, the duration may not exceed two years
There is no limit on the number of times academic leave can be granted to a student during their studies
To request academic leave, the student must submit a personal application to the University Director
The application form is specified in Appendix 1 to the Regulation
For medical indications: a medical conclusion issued by a healthcare organization within the state or municipal health system

For military service: a mobilization notice, order, or summons from the military commissariat containing the time and place of dispatch to the place of military service, and a copy of the contract for military service in the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation, certified in the manner established by Russian legislation
For other exceptional cases: other documents confirming the grounds for the leave, if available
The decision to grant academic leave is made by the University Director or an authorized official within 10 days from the date of receiving the application and attached documents
The leave is formalized by an order issued by the University Head no later than 5 working days from the date the decision to grant the leave is made
During the academic leave, the student is released from obligations related to mastering the educational program and is not admitted to the educational process until the leave ends
Educational relations are suspended during this period
If the student is enrolled under a contract, tuition fees are not charged during the academic leave
Academic leave ends upon the expiration of the period for which it was granted, or earlier based on the student's application
The application form for early termination is specified in Appendix 4 to the order
If the leave ends early, the student is admitted to studies based on an order from the University Head
Upon completion of the leave, the student is admitted to studies based on an order from the University Director or an authorized official
The evidence does not specify the exact content or submission method for Appendix 1 or Appendix 4
The evidence does not define what constitutes "other exceptional cases" beyond natural disasters and family circumstances

The evidence does not specify the procedure for resuming studies if the leave was granted for medical reasons and the student needs to provide a new medical certificate upon return, only stating that admission is based on an order
The evidence does not specify what happens to academic progress or grades accrued before the leave
